entities.summary: Asadkhuja Muydinkhujaev is an Uzbek boxer, gold medalist of 2023 IBA Men's World Boxing Championships in welterweight category and bronze medalist of 2022 Asian Amateur Boxing Championships that held in Amman, Jordan. Asadkhuja also won gold at the 2024 Summer Olympics in the welterweight category.
